departure_106_1: Departure from the split policy's wording, accepted as the lead's decision 106.1: data-tuned parts are fitted on the tuning pool T only (here r3-P15's feature scalings and r3-P13's exploration), not built on exploration half A, and each reading is made once on all eligible creators (r3-P01, r3-P15 and r3-P17 are unsplit by the policy itself). Reason: T sits on the exploration side and is never read for a split reading, so fitting on T alone keeps both halves out of every fit (decision 88's reading). Limitation: half B is no longer sealed for the acoustic measures described here.
